observations: Photo shows a disassembled engine block with intake manifold and attached transmission/gearbox, sitting on a workshop floor.
Other engine assemblies are visible in the background, suggesting a used-parts dealer's yard.
No engine code, VIN plate, or Toyota nameplate is legible anywhere in the photo.
No visible oil leaks or missing parts, but wiring harness, sensors, starter and ancillaries are not clearly shown.
A watermark reading 'Blessed Chi...' overlays the image; no other text is legible.

identity.kind: used car engine and gearbox assembly (seller claims Toyota Corolla 2005, 1ZZ engine)

claims.claim: This is a Toyota Corolla 2005 engine and gearbox
claims.evidence: No VIN tag, vehicle badge, or chassis plate visible in photo 0.
No stamped engine code or casting number is legible in photo 0.

claims.claim: Engine and gearbox are a matched, complete, working set
claims.evidence: No start-up footage, compression test, or gearbox tag shown; completeness of sensors/harness not visible.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal faults (compression, timing chain, valve train wear)
risks.proof: Video clip of engine cranking/running with audio

risks.risk: Engine code could be mislabeled (not genuine 1ZZ-FE)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped engine code on the block
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified base engine, not premium 1ZZ-specific price

risks.risk: Gearbox may not be the matching/compatible unit for this engine
risks.proof: Photo of gearbox ID tag/code alongside engine code

risks.risk: Missing ancillaries (ECU, harness, sensors, starter, alternator) could raise total cost to make it usable
risks.proof: Full walk-around photos showing harness, sensors, starter and alternator attached
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block without ancillaries

risks.risk: Hidden leaks or damage (oil pan, gaskets, cracks)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of oil pan, valve cover, and block seams
Odometer photo or service history from donor car

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the stamped engine code on the block
Video of the engine cranking or running
Photo of the gearbox ID tag/code
Photos showing wiring harness, sensors, starter, and alternator still attached
Close-up of oil pan and gasket areas for leak signs
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used engine-and-gearbox assembly, but none of the seller's specific claims (Corolla 2005, 1ZZ engine, working condition) can be confirmed from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, untested bare assembly.
